notes: Durham puts its zoning district in parusecode (e.g. RS-10, RU-5(2), PDR 3.440) and the county land-use description in parusedesc, which carries vacancy itself (VAC RES/...)
parusecd2 is the assessor's building type (empty when there is no building); parusedesc is the land use. A residential land use with no building value is vacant
parusecd2 is Wake's Type & Use code and parusedesc its one-letter Land Class (parusecode repeats the class as a three-letter code: RHS = R). A homesite class with no building value is vacant
